profile.headline: Web Developer / Designer, UI/UX Developer / Designer
profile.jobTitle: Freelance Web Developer / Designer, UI/UX Developer / Designer
profile.summary:
Responsive, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Custom WordPress coding. Graphic Designer and Web Designer. Extensive four-color, B&W, spot color, and separations knowledge and experience. WordPress custom theme designer and developer. Work great either with a team or alone. Excellent attention to detail. Redesign previously produced artwork. Routinely work with Heads of Departments, Art Directors, Copywriters, Creative Directors, customers, vendors, and clients to ensure output and design specifications are met. Timely design and/or preparation and production of websites, web banners, emails, apps, business cards, billboards, pylons, posters, air fresheners, newsletters, banners, nameplates, flyers, pamphlets, magazines, personalized stationary, newspapers, etc…

Proven ability to:

• Control Quality
• Create Commercial Graphics
• Meet Any Output Specification
• Troubleshoot Quickly, Accurately, and Effectively
• Operate on a Personal Level With Advertisers, Customers, and Vendors
• Meet The Design Needs Of Creative Directors, Art Directors, and Clients

If you like what you see please get in touch, I would love to hear from you. I'm open to anything from freelance work to a full-time position.

Specialties: I have over twenty-five years of experience working with Adobe Photoshop, QuarkXPress, Adobe InDesign, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. I also have over fifteen years of experience with Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Acrobat Pro, and Adobe Dreamweaver as well as over fifteen with custom WordPress coding. I am proficient on either a Mac or PC platform and with most of the current Adobe Creative Suite software.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer / Designer, UI/UX Developer / Designer
positions.description: Skills: Back-End Web Development · REST APIs · Tracking Systems · Web Architecture · PHP · Adobe Creative Suite · Reliability · PSD to Wordpress · Git · Attention to Detail · Responsive Web Design · jQuery · WordPress

positions.title: IT Manager / Sr. Web Developer
positions.description: Maintain current systems for employees. Create new solutions for asset management including laptops, monitors, keyboards, and any other equipment employees need. Manage MDM for all laptops and ensure hardening and compliance measures are implemented and updated. Implement solutions, including a ticketing system, for IT Ops for troubleshooting Client issues with their websites. Continue all responsibilities of Sr. Web Developer.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description: Translate visual designs into functional interfaces, ensuring that the execution aligns with established branding and design guidelines with meticulous attention to detail. Collaborate with project leads, project managers, designers, developers, and account managers to plan, estimate, and define project requirements. Utilize motion and user feedback to create fluid and engaging user experiences, optimizing performance for various client devices, from desktop computers to mobile devices. Comfortably handle changing project requirements, adapt to shifting project directions, and provide alternative project plans or contingencies when necessary. Effectively use various communication channels (Slack, Asana, email) to drive project progress and ensure clarity. Proactively communicate to maximize problem-solving options. Manage my time efficiently without the need for daily oversight, ensuring timely project delivery. Identify project issues early in the development process and recommend plans of action or contingencies to maximize project options. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive decision-making processes and ensure alignment across various project aspects. Lead development teams, mentor and train junior and mid-level developers.
